grain: sighting.id; reports, not unique physical events
coordinates: sighting.lat/lng; location fallback only if null. Precision not verified.
regional_rule: State label or explicit context bounds; known non-US countries excluded. Unknown countries retained and counted.
snapshot: complete query results, compact field projection, no sampling

general.query:
SELECT s.id, s.source_db_id, s.source_record_id, s.date_event, s.date_event_raw,
s.date_reported, s.date_posted, s.shape, s.standardized_shape, s.duration_seconds,
s.num_witnesses, s.source_ref, s.lat, s.lng, s.has_photo, s.has_video,
l.city, l.state AS region, l.country, l.latitude AS location_lat,
l.longitude AS location_lon, l.geocode_src, d.name AS database_name, d.url AS database_url FROM sighting s LEFT JOIN location l ON l.id=s.location_id LEFT JOIN source_database d ON d.id=s.source_db_id WHERE lower(l.state) IN ('ca','california','nv','nevada') AND ((s.date_event >= '1990' AND s.date_event < '2000') OR (s.date_event >= '2020' AND s.date_event < '2024')) AND (l.country IS NULL OR trim(l.country)='' OR lower(l.country) IN ('us','usa','united states','united states of america')) ORDER BY s.date_event,s.id

roswell.query:
SELECT s.id, s.source_db_id, s.source_record_id, s.date_event, s.date_event_raw,
s.date_reported, s.date_posted, s.shape, s.standardized_shape, s.duration_seconds,
s.num_witnesses, s.source_ref, s.lat, s.lng, s.has_photo, s.has_video,
l.city, l.state AS region, l.country, l.latitude AS location_lat,
l.longitude AS location_lon, l.geocode_src, d.name AS database_name, d.url AS database_url FROM sighting s LEFT JOIN location l ON l.id=s.location_id LEFT JOIN source_database d ON d.id=s.source_db_id WHERE s.date_event >= '1944' AND s.date_event < '1951' AND (l.country IS NULL OR trim(l.country)='' OR lower(l.country) IN ('us','usa','united states','united states of america')) AND (lower(l.state) IN ('nm','new mexico','nuevo mexico') OR (coalesce(s.lat,l.latitude) BETWEEN 31 AND 37 AND coalesce(s.lng,l.longitude) BETWEEN -109 AND -103)) ORDER BY s.date_event,s.id
